DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_BLOOD_FEAST.title: Bloodfeast
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_BLOOD_FEAST.descriptio: When [red]Bleed[/red] triggers, gain [red]Bloodfeast[/red] equal to the [red]Bleed[/red] that triggered.
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_CORRUPTION.title: Corruption
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_CORRUPTION.description:
Max 100.
Every 10 [gold]Corruption[/gold] gives non-[gold]Knight[/gold] cards +5% final damage.
Every 10 points below 100 gives [gold]Knight[/gold] cards +5% final damage.
Cards are corrupted when the threshold is reached.
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_BLOOD_IMPULSE.title: Returning Bloodlust
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_BLOOD_IMPULSE.descript: Every 5 stacks applies 1 additional [red]Bleed[/red] layer when you apply [red]Bleed[/red]. Each stack applies 1 additional [red]Bleed[/red] and increases damage dealt by 1%.
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_WAVERING.title: Shimmering【Bloodfiend】
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_WAVERING.description: At the end of your turn, gain Block equal to its stacks. At the start of your next turn, lose half of its stacks (rounded up).
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_BLEED.title: Bleed
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_BLEED.description: When the enemy acts, it takes {Amount} damage and loses 1 layer.
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_BLEED_LAYERS.title: Bleed Layers
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_BLEED_LAYERS.descripti: Remaining [red]Bleed[/red] layers (shown to the right of the icon; [red]Bleed[/red] is on the left).
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_DUEL_TARGET.title: Duel Target
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_DUEL_TARGET.descriptio:
Max 1. Final damage dealt to and taken from the applier is increased by 50%; final damage dealt to and taken from anyone else is 0.
Loses 1 stack at the end of that enemy's turn.
After this unit is affected by an effect, each 100 damage it takes this turn grants the applier 1 [gold]Duel Glory[/gold] (ignores [gold]Artifact[/gold]).
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_DUEL_GLORY.title: Duel Glory
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_DUEL_GLORY.description: Max 2 stacks. Loses 1 stack at turn end and grants an extra turn.
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_KNIGHT_DREAM.title: A Knight's Dream
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_KNIGHT_DREAM.descripti: Gain Block equal to this whenever you play a Skill.
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_IRRESPONSIBLE_DREAM.de: Corrupted cards have a 50% chance to be replayed once.
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_TEMPORARY_STRENGTH.des: Deals extra damage equal to this for this turn; fades at the end of the turn.
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_HARD_BLOOD.title: Hardblood
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_HARD_BLOOD.description: Cards that spend [gold]Hardblood[/gold] gain 2 base damage per point spent. They can still be played without enough [gold]Hardblood[/gold].
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_BLOOD_ARMOR.title: Blood Armor
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_BLOOD_ARMOR.descriptio: Keeps up to this much Block for your next turn; loses 1 stack at end of turn.
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_BLOOD_THORNS.title: Blood-Woven Thorns
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_BLOOD_THORNS.descripti: When hit by an attack that makes it lose HP, apply 3X [red]Bleed[/red] to the attacker and lose 1 stack.
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_CLOTTING_BLOOD.title: Clotting Blood
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_CLOTTING_BLOOD.descrip: The target cannot act for this many turns (ignores [gold]Artifact[/gold]).
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_RESPONSIBILITY.title: Responsibility
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_RESPONSIBILITY.descrip:
Deals and takes +20% base damage.
Whenever Don Quixote gains [gold]Shimmering【Bloodfiend】[/gold], each character with [gold]Kindred[/gold] also gains half that amount (rounded up).
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_FOLLOWER.title: Kindred
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_FOLLOWER.description:
Whenever a card is played, this unit loses 5 HP and Don Quixote gains 5 [red]Bloodfeast[/red]; heals 10% of the damage it deals.
At most two [gold]Kindred[/gold] may exist; when a third appears, the most recently converted Kindred becomes a [gold]Blood Bag[/gold].
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_FEAST_TOTAL.title: Total Bloodfeast Spent
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_FEAST_TOTAL.descriptio:
Increases whenever [red]Bloodfeast[/red] is spent.
Each point of [red]Total Bloodfeast Spent[/red] gives cards with the [red]Bleed[/red] keyword +1% final damage.
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_BLOOD_BAG.title: Blood Bag
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_BLOOD_BAG.description:
When Don Quixote plays a card that spends [red]Bloodfeast[/red] and lacks it, the difference is paid with HP.
Heals 5% of damage dealt.
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_ALL_CLOTTED_BLOOD.desc: [red]Bleed[/red] damage you take is reduced by {Amount}%.
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_GOOD_IDEA_FORM.title: Form of a Good Idea
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_LATENT_BLOOD.title: Latent Blood
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_SHATTERED_HARD_BLOOD.d: This turn, whenever you draw a card, apply 1 [red]Bleed[/red] to all enemies.
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_BLOOD_RECAST.title: Blood Recast
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_DREADFUL_DISEASE.title: Inescapable Dreadful Disease
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_DREADFUL_DISEASE.descr: At the start of your turn, apply {Amount} [red]Bleed[/red] layers to all enemies.
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_BLOOD_SWEEP.title: Clearing The Path
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_BLOOD_SWEEP.descriptio: Your [gold]Lance Gorged on Blood[/gold] now hits all enemies.
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_WOUND_DESTRUCTION.desc:
Lasts {Amount} turn(s).
Decreases by 1 at the end of the enemy's turn.
The affected enemy takes 1.5x [red]Bleed[/red] damage (does not increase [red]Bloodfeast[/red] gained).
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_BLOODFIEND_MIGHT.title: Bloodfiend Might
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_BLOODFIEND_MIGHT.descr:
Whenever you attack, heal 2 HP.
At the start of each turn, gain 2 [gold]Temporary Strength[/gold].
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_ETERNAL_THIRST.title: Eternal Thirst
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_ETERNAL_THIRST.descrip:
At the start of each turn, spend up to 30 [red]Bloodfeast[/red] and heal based on the amount spent.
Then trigger 1 [red]Bleed[/red] on all enemies and reduce 1 layer.
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_BLOOD_FEAST_LOCK.title: Bloodfeast Lock
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_BLOOD_FEAST_LOCK.descr: You cannot play cards that spend [red]Bloodfeast[/red] this turn.
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_DUEL_RENEWAL.title: Duel Renewal
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_DUEL_RENEWAL.descripti: Duel Target does not expire; it consumes 1 stack of this instead.
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_BRAVE_HEART.title: Heart of a Brave Knight
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_BRAVE_HEART.descriptio:
Take 25% less damage.
Cards with the [gold]Knight[/gold] keyword gain +5% base damage and cost 1 less.
Does not stack.
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_HOPE.title: Hope
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_HOPE.description: The next Attack you play deals +25% damage per stack. Removed after that Attack is played.
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_GUARD_ASSIST.title: Guard Assist
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_GUARD_ASSIST.descripti:
Maximum 1 stack. Loses 1 stack at the start of your turn and 1 more after triggering.
When an enemy attack would make any ally lose HP, if Guard Riposte deals more damage than that single hit, interrupt the attack and play Guard Riposte once per original hit.
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_REINFORCED_DEFENSE.des: Shimmering【Bloodfiend】 lasts 1 more turn before halving (upgraded: Blood Armor no longer decays).
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_GRIT.title: Extraordinary Grit
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_GRIT.description: Take {Amount}% less damage until the end of the enemy turn.
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_GRIT_CAP.title: Extraordinary Grit
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_GRIT_CAP.description: Take at most {Amount} damage from each hit until the end of the enemy turn.
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_HAPPY_SMILE_LAND.title: Where Happy Smiles Bloom Like Flowers
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_HAPPY_SMILE_LAND.descr:
At the start of your turn, all allies gain 3 [gold]Blood-Woven Thorns[/gold] and 20 [gold]Shimmering【Bloodfiend】[/gold], and their debuffs are cleared.
While this lasts, [gold]Shimmering【Bloodfiend】[/gold] does not wear off at the start of your turn.
{Amount} turns left.
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_NIGHTMARE_LAND.title: The Nightmarish La Manchaland
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_NIGHTMARE_LAND.descrip:
At the start of your turn, all allies double their buffs and lose all debuffs; all enemies double their debuffs and lose all buffs (Sandpit excepted).
While this lasts, [gold]Shimmering【Bloodfiend】[/gold] does not wear off at the start of your turn.
{Amount} turns left.
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_WHITE_MOON_KNIGHT.desc:
Max 1 stack. Deals 1% more damage per point of the opponent's [gold]Corruption[/gold]; an opponent with 0 [gold]Corruption[/gold] counts as +50% damage.
Gains 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] every 3 times it is attacked.
Takes 75% less [red]Bleed[/red] damage.
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_WHITE_MOON_DUEL.title: Knight of the White Moon - Duel Target
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_WHITE_MOON_DUEL.descri:
Max 1. The unit with this status deals and takes 50% more final damage.
While it is in play, the Knight of the White Moon can only damage units that have it, and only takes damage from units that have it.
Loses 1 stack at the end of the opponent's turn.
After the unit with this status is affected by an effect, each 80 damage it takes grants the Knight of the White Moon 1 [gold]Duel Glory[/gold] (ignores [gold]Artifact[/gold]).
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_WHITE_MOON_GLORY.title: Knight of the White Moon - Duel Glory
DON_QUIXOTE_POWER_WHITE_MOON_GLORY.descr: Max 2 stacks. This turn, also gains the intent of the following turn.
